description:
*Lezhin Comics and writer Kim Jeong-hyun have made a webtoon of the Fuji TV drama [메꽃], which hit the Japanese summer in 2014!*

Rikako says that an affair with Sawa, an ordinary housewife who only looks at her husband, can protect her family. The two people, who seemed to have absolutely nothing in common, were no different except for their redness at 3pm. Their affair secretly bloomed through their guilt. Forgivable and unforgivable sins, how about you?

*Based on "Hirugao ～Love Affairs in the Afternoon～" produced by Fuji Television Network., Inc. (Scripted by Yumiko Inoue)*

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hirugao)
